title: Right q-vector calculus at integral superdimension: localized decompositions and resonance
summary: We specialize the intrinsic right $q$-vector derivative on radial algebras to integral superdimension. The formal dimension is encoded by an independent coefficient $Q$, and formal radial superspace of superdimension $M=m-2n$ is obtained by the coefficient specialization $Q\mapsto q^M$. This gives a rigorous universal calculus and, on finite blocks containing at most $m$ abstract vectors, a faithful coordinate realization on $\mathbb R^{m|2n}$.
